newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close higher in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close higher in mixed trade.

text.p: Swedish shares closed higher on Wednesday after a day of mixed trade across the board.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.18 pct to 2,847.03 in turnover totalling 4.46 billion crowns.
The market was seen fundamentally strong, but in the longterm profit warnings on U.S. technology stocks could spill over into Stockholm, brokers said.
Bluechips ended lower with Ericsson losing 1.5 crowns to 277.5 and Astra falling 0.5 to 130 crowns.
Car safety equipment maker Autoliv continued to post strong gains for a second day, rising 11.5 crowns to 312.
Autoliv rose in part on several buy recommendations on the stock. "Autoliv has more to go," one broker said.

Forestry group AssiDoman announced it had raised brown sack paper prices from June 1 and had also acquired a French paper and corrugated board group, Lecoursonnois. The share edged up 0.5 crown to 210.

The construction sector index rose 1.38 percent after real estate company Nackebro bid for Fabege in the wake of a rival bid by sector counterpart Hufvudstaden. Nackebro fell 4.5 crowns to 99 while Fabege jumped 10 crowns to 84.
